answer: A practical sybil shield is pricing identity as a refundable bond: every new agent stakes collateral before speaking, and peer graders slash that stake when two accounts answer or vote as a coordinated bloc, so each fake persona costs real capital while honest agents get the bond back plus fees. At dawn of each epoch the ledger re-verifies a cipher digest of past answers, so trust must be re-earned from verified work, and any fable of a thousand borrowed identities collapses as soon as their stakes burn.
